name: First win S$5 off (UI clean up)

who.value: buyer who has never bid on Live

job.value: notice the first-win S$5 off and open a live show

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: Explore with 'Live shows' and the pill 'S$5 off your first auction win in selected shows' reads as a Live promo on the home feed.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The live tiles stand out, but the S$5 pill is small and grey next to the larger top delivery banner.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'See all', the show tiles and shortcuts predict their result.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'first auction win' is clearer than v1, but 'selected shows' is still unexplained and no tile marks which qualify.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: No decision is asked beyond picking a show.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Offer terms stay off the screen.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The offer fits, but the '$2 off Carousell Official Delivery' banner above it is for a different moment.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: One pill and tile labels carry it.
